$comment: F7 security headers for the Render static site agricarbon-web-staging (= https://agricarbon.info.vn). Stage N is applied by a PR that copies render-yaml.mjs output for that stage into render.yaml. The Blueprint 'tec' auto-syncs render.yaml from main, so MERGING that PR IS THE ROLLOUT. This file itself changes nothing in production.

inlineHandlerHashes.$comment: index.html: <link ... media="print" onload="this.media='all'"> (non-render-blocking webfont). sha256 of the exact attribute value. If index.html changes that handler, this hash must change too (the harness checks that the webfont is applied).

policy.$comment: The full CSP the app needs, measured with the harness (csp.spec.ts) on the production bundle. Report-Only in stage 1, enforced from stage 2.

0.description: Current production (2026-11-06): only X-Content-Type-Options, which Render sends itself. Rollback target for every later stage.

1.description: No-break hardening. Anti-framing and the structural CSP directives are ENFORCED (frame-ancestors is ignored in Report-Only); script/style/connect restrictions are Report-Only. HSTS 5 minutes, this host only.

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), serial=(), bluetooth=(), hid=(), midi=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=(), display-capture=(), clipboard-write=(self)

2.description: Full CSP enforced after stage 1 shows no violation (harness on the live headers, plus the Manager/Farmer real QA). HSTS 1 day.

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), serial=(), bluetooth=(), hid=(), midi=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=(), display-capture=(), clipboard-write=(self)

3.description: HSTS one year for this host. includeSubDomains and preload stay OFF until every subdomain of agricarbon.info.vn is audited (DNS is in Cloudflare; not visible to this review).

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), serial=(), bluetooth=(), hid=(), midi=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=(), display-capture=(), clipboard-write=(self)

hostProvided.$comment: Sent by Render itself on every response (checked 2026-11-06 at the origin and through the CDN). Not set in render.yaml, so it is never duplicated ("nosniff, nosniff"); --verify still requires it.
